title: exRNA BioFluids explorer
bodyHtml:
The exGLid Explorer

The exGLid Explorer Tool identifies extracellular RNAs (exRNAs) expressed in human serum, plasma, cerebrospinal fluid, urine, and saliva across 60 datasets in the exRNA Atlas. This interface was developed through a collaboration between the exRNA Data Coordinating Center and the CFDE Knowledge Center.

We created the GLid Registry as a registration and naming service which was then used to create exGLids (extracellular RNA Genomic Location ids) from GLids, which serve as unique identifiers for exRNA loci. These exGLids are available through the exGLid Explorer Tool deployed via the CFDE Knowledge Center Portal.

Example Use Case: Identify Potential exRNA Biomarkers

To identify candidate exRNA biomarkers, one may start by searching for one or more gene names (e.g., PPARG, PCSK9, SLC30A8) using the “Gene” search box, or by a single region of hg19 human genome coordinates (e.g., 19:44905797-4490582) using the “Region” search box.

For queried gene(s), the number of exGLs will be summarized for each gene and biofluid combination. Click "show" for an expanded view of each row.

For queried GRCh37/hg19 genome coordinates, filter for results relevant to a specific biofluid(s), exGLid, exRNA Atlas Dataset, gene type, and/or ENCODE regulatory element.

More detailed background information on exGLids is available here.
